# Selman Utku (selmanutku.com)

> Dijital Dönüşüm | İnovasyon | Spor Teknolojileri — "Sporun Geleceğine Stratejik Bakış."
> Digital Transformation | Innovation | Sports Technology — "A Strategic Vision for the Future of Sports."

## Summary
Selman Utku is an Istanbul, Türkiye-based Tech Analyst, digital transformation professional, and SportTech entrepreneur working at the intersection of sports management, information technologies, business analysis, and AI-driven process automation.

- **Website:** https://selmanutku.com
- **Location:** Istanbul, Türkiye (TR-34)
- **Languages:** Turkish (TR), English (EN)
- **Email:** iletisim@selmanutku.com
- **LinkedIn:** https://www.linkedin.com/in/selmanutku
- **Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/selmanutku
- **Google Scholar:** https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=Selman+Utku
- **Portrait Image:** https://selmanutku.com/assets/aistudio/selman-utku-com_c1d77ca5.png

## Core Expertise
1. **Dijital Dönüşüm & İş Analizi (Digital Transformation & Business Analysis):** Enterprise process analysis, requirements engineering, workflow modernization, and data-driven decision architecture.
2. **Yapay Zekâ & Otomasyon (Artificial Intelligence & Automation):** Practical AI integration, workflow automation, operational efficiency, and institutional productivity systems.
3. **Spor Teknolojileri / SportTech (Sports Technology):** Scalable digital management platforms and product ecosystems for sports academies, clubs, and facilities.
4. **İnovasyon & Teknoloji Stratejisi (Innovation & Technology Strategy):** Turning institutional needs into sustainable digital product roadmaps and measurable organizational value.

## Career Highlights
- **Tech Analyst** — Enterprise software analysis, requirements management, process modernization, and bridging business units with engineering teams.
- **Founder, Sporsepeti (https://sporsepeti.com.tr)** — Sports information technology venture offering digital management software, event discovery platforms, and sports content for clubs, businesses, and sports enthusiasts.
- **Founder, SportsFly (https://sportsfly.com.tr)** — End-to-end SaaS management platform for sports academies, clubs, and athletic facilities.
- **Founder, SportTech Türkiye (https://sporttech.com.tr)** — Sports technology ecosystem, innovation hub, and community network in Türkiye.
- **Spor ve Dijital Stratejiler Koordinatörü (Sports & Digital Strategies Coordinator), University** — Digitalization of university sports organizations, strategic planning, and stakeholder coordination.
- **Dijital Kanallar Uzmanı (Digital Channels Specialist), University** — Institutional digital channels, user experience optimization, and analytics-driven communication architecture.

- [SportsFly](https://sportsfly.com.tr) ([Case Study](https://selmanutku.com/projeler/sportsfly)): End-to-end digital management platform for sports academies, clubs, athlete tracking, and operations.
